inv.desc_es: NAVE DE 400M2 EN POL. EMPRESARIUM. Empresarium es una zona industrial de referencia en Zaragoza. Nave de 314m2 en planta baja más entreplanta de 83m2 en el recinto de Calle Romero, 29, de Pol. Empresarium, Zaragoza. A 10 minutos en coche de Zaragoza mediante la autovía A-68. Cuenta con buenas conexiones por carretera a cualquier parte de la ciudad mediante las circunvalaciones Z-30 y Z-40. Construida en estructura de hormigón con muros de bloque y cubierta de chapa metálica con cielorraso aislante de panel de lana de roca. La nave cuenta con instalación eléctrica trifásica, aseo con ducha y oficinas, las cuales están siendo actualmente reformadas. Puertas diferenciadas para peatones y vehículos (basculante de 4,50m de altura). La nave cuenta con buen acceso para todo tipo de furgonetas y vehículos ligeros. El recinto cuenta con cerramiento perimetral y sistema de videovigilancia 24 horas Altura libre de la nave: 8,00m Llámenos para ampliar información. Tenemos oficina en el mismo polígono. Amplio equipo profesional. Disponemos de la mayor cartera de naves en Aragón. Equipo técnico propio para el estudio análisis de aprovechamiento, viabilidad del inmueble, normativa urbanística, valoración y tasación. GTI, asesorando a particulares y empresas desde 1990. inv.desc_en: 400M2 INDUSTRIAL UNIT IN POL. EMPRESARIUM. Empresarium is a benchmark industrial area in Zaragoza. 314m2 unit on the ground floor plus an 83m2 mezzanine located at Calle Romero, 29, in Pol. Empresarium, Zaragoza. A 10-minute drive from Zaragoza via the A-68 motorway. It has good road connections to any part of the city via the Z-30 and Z-40 ring roads. Built with a concrete structure with block walls and a metal sheet roof with an insulating rock wool panel ceiling. The unit has a three-phase electrical installation, a restroom with a shower, and offices, which are currently being renovated. Separate doors for pedestrians and vehicles (4.50m high overhead door). The unit has good access for all types of vans and light vehicles. The complex has perimeter fencing and a 24-hour video surveillance system. Clear height of the unit: 8.00m. Call us for more information. We have an office in the same industrial park. Large professional team. We have the largest portfolio of industrial units in Aragon. Our own technical team for the study and analysis of utilization, property viability, urban planning regulations, valuation, and appraisal. GTI, advising individuals and companies since 1990. We help our clients choose the option that best suits their needs, 35 years of experience in the real estate sector. Information and commercial conditions without contractual validity. Offices: This property has a space designated for offices for the proper management of your business, providing a centralized space for administration and staff. Restrooms/Services: For greater comfort, this property has restroom facilities and essential services, thus promoting a healthy work environment. Lighting: The property is already equipped with lighting to meet your operational needs. Mezzanine: Take advantage of the vertical space with a mezzanine that gives you additional storage or production options. Electrical Installation: Ensure the electrical safety of your operations with a certified installation that complies with all regulations. Showers: Facilities equipped with showers for staff.
